name: Denti-Cal
description: Medi-Cal Dental (formerly called Denti-Cal) is California's Medicaid dental program, providing free or low-cost dental care to Medi-Cal members of all ages.
fullDescription: Medi-Cal Dental (formerly called Denti-Cal) is California's Medicaid dental program, providing free or low-cost dental care to Medi-Cal members of all ages.
whatTheyOffer:
- Preventive care (cleanings, exams, x-rays, fluoride)
- Restorative services (fillings, crowns)
- Extractions and oral surgery
- Dentures and partials
- Emergency dental services
- Orthodontics for children under 21 (when medically necessary)
howToGetIt: If you have Medi-Cal, dental benefits are included. Find a Medi-Cal dentist with the online Find-A-Dentist search or call the Medi-Cal Dental Telephone Service Center at 1-800-322-6384 (free call, Mon-Fri 8am-5pm). Starting July 1, 2027, some adult members will lose full dental benefits based on immigration status (emergency dental care stays covered); children under 19, pregnant and postpartum members, and former foster youth under 26 keep full benefits.
keywords: Denti-Cal, Medi-Cal Dental, Medicaid dental, free dental, Medi-Cal, cleanings, fillings, extractions, dentures, orthodontics, oral surgery
